spans.s: मय् abbreviated term or pratyāhāra for all the consonants of the five classes or Vargas excepting the consonant ञ्; cf. मय उञो वो वा
मय tad. affix मयट् (1) in the sense of proceeding therefrom (तत आगत:

) added to words showing cause or meaning human being; e.g. सममयम्, देवदत्तमयम्: (2) in the sense of product (विकार) or part (अवयव) added optionally with अण् to any word, e.g. अश्ममयम् , आश्मनम् मूर्वामयम् मौर्वम्, and necessarily to words beginning with आ, ऐ and औ, words of the class headed by the word शर and the words गो, पिष्ट, व्रीहि, तिल and some others: cf.
-150; (3) in the sense of proportion, added to a numeral; e. g. द्विमयमुदश्विद्यवानाम्; cf.
; (4) in the sense of "made up of' added to the thing of which there is a large quantity; e.g. अन्नमयम्, अपूपमयम् cf; तत्प्रकृतवचने मयट्

मयूरव्यंसकादि a class of compounds of the type of मयूरव्यंसक which are somewhat irregular formations and hence mentioned as they are found in use. The compounds are called simple tatpuruṣa compounds; e.g. मयूरव्यंसक: हस्तेगृह्य, एहिपचम्, उच्चावचम्, खादतमोदता etc.; cf. मयूरव्यंसकादयश्च
